run_multinode_training: run multinode flow matching training on a Slurm cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_slurm_job: submit a flow matching training job to a Slurm partition with custom GPU count and timeout settings
parse_training_args: parse command line arguments for submitit training including ngpus, nodes, timeout, partition, and slurm constraints
setup_trainer_checkpoint: setup a Trainer that checkpoints and requeues flow matching training jobs with resume support
create_init_file: create a unique initialization file in a shared folder for distributed training coordination
